description: Compare charge composition of the PAM-binding surface patch between E. coli Cse1 and structurally mapped P. aeruginosa Cas8e
code:
import numpy as np, os, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd(); exec(open(os.path.join(OUT,"strucaln.py")).read(), globals())
ri_ec, seq_ec, ca_ec = read_ca(os.path.join(OUT,"5H9F_chainA_Cse1.pdb"))
ri_pa, seq_pa, ca_pa = read_ca(os.path.join(OUT,"AF_A0A3S4PYN6.pdb"))

# all-atom E. coli Cse1 + PAM duplex atoms
def atoms(path, chains=None):
    out=[]
    for l in open(path):
        if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[16] in (" ","A"):
            if chains and l[21] not in chains: continue
            out.append((l[21], int(l[22:26]), l[12:16].strip(), l[17:20].strip(),
                        np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])))
    return out
prot=atoms(os.path.join(OUT,"5H9F_chainA_Cse1.pdb"))
dna =atoms(os.path.join(OUT,"5H9F_DNA.pdb"))
PAM={("M",16),("M",17),("M",18),("N",33),("N",34),("N",35)}
pam_xyz=np.array([a[4] for a in dna if (a[0],a[1]) in PAM])
pxyz=np.array([a[4] for a in prot]); pres=[a[1] for a in prot]
Dp=np.linalg.norm(pxyz[:,None,:]-pam_xyz[None,:,:],axis=2).min(1)

CH={'K':1,'R':1,'D':-1,'E':-1}
ecidx={r:k for k,r in enumerate(ri_ec)}
A=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"struct_align_Pa_Ec.json")))
# recompute refined mapping (same procedure as before)
R=np.array(A["R"]); t=np.array(A["t"]); pairs=[(a,b) for a,b in A["pairs"]]
WIN=[(95,175),(255,285),(340,365)]
inwin=lambda rn: any(a<=rn<=b for a,b in WIN)
for cycle in range(4):
    At=(R@ca_pa.T).T+t
    sel=[(i,j) for i,j in pairs if inwin(ri_ec[j]) and np.linalg.norm(At[i]-ca_ec[j])<10]
    ii=np.array([i for i,_ in sel]); jj=np.array([j for _,j in sel])
    R,t=kabsch(ca_pa[ii], ca_ec[jj]); At=(R@ca_pa.T).T+t
    D=np.linalg.norm(At[:,None,:]-ca_ec[None,:,:],axis=2)
    pairs=nw_scored(1.0/(1.0+(D/4.0)**2), gap=-0.4)
mapEc={j:i for i,j in pairs}

print(f"{'cutoff':>7} {'n_Ec':>5} {'Ec K/R':>7} {'Ec D/E':>7} {'Ec net':>7} | {'n_Pa_mapped':>11} {'Pa K/R':>7} {'Pa D/E':>7} {'Pa net':>7} {'maxCAdist':>9}")
summary=[]
for cut in [6,8,10,12,15]:
    rset=sorted({pres[i] for i in range(len(pres)) if Dp[i]<cut})
    ecaa=[seq_ec[ecidx[r]] for r in rset]
    paaa=[]; dists=[]
    for r in rset:
        k=ecidx[r]
        if k in mapEc:
            i=mapEc[k]; paaa.append(seq_pa[i]); dists.append(float(np.linalg.norm(At[i]-ca_ec[k])))
    ecK=sum(1 for a in ecaa if a in 'KR'); ecD=sum(1 for a in ecaa if a in 'DE')
    paK=sum(1 for a in paaa if a in 'KR'); paD=sum(1 for a in paaa if a in 'DE')
    print(f"{cut:>7} {len(rset):>5} {ecK:>7} {ecD:>7} {ecK-ecD:>+7} | {len(paaa):>11} {paK:>7} {paD:>7} {paK-paD:>+7} {max(dists):>9.1f}")
    summary.append(dict(cut=cut,n=len(rset),ecK=ecK,ecD=ecD,ecnet=ecK-ecD,npa=len(paaa),paK=paK,paD=paD,panet=paK-paD))
    if cut==12:
        ident=sum(1 for a,b in zip([seq_ec[ecidx[r]] for r in rset if ecidx[r] in mapEc], paaa) if a==b)
        print(f"        -> identity across the 12 A PAM patch: {ident}/{len(paaa)} = {100*ident/len(paaa):.0f}%")
json.dump(summary, open(os.path.join(OUT,"pam_patch_charge.json"),"w"))

# ---- figure ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(11,4.2))
cuts=[s["cut"] for s in summary]
w=0.35; x=np.arange(len(cuts))
axes[0].bar(x-w/2,[s["ecK"] for s in summary],w,label="Lys+Arg",color="#2c6fbb")
axes[0].bar(x-w/2,[-s["ecD"] for s in summary],w,label="Asp+Glu",color="#c0392b")
axes[0].bar(x+w/2,[s["paK"] for s in summary],w,color="#2c6fbb",alpha=0.55)
axes[0].bar(x+w/2,[-s["paD"] for s in summary],w,color="#c0392b",alpha=0.55)
axes[0].axhline(0,color="k",lw=0.8); axes[0].set_xticks(x); axes[0].set_xticklabels([f"{c} A" for c in cuts])
axes[0].set_xlabel("shell around the PAM duplex"); axes[0].set_ylabel("residue count")
axes[0].set_title("Charged residues in the PAM-binding patch\n(solid: E. coli Cse1, pale: P. aeruginosa Cas8e)")
axes[0].legend(fontsize=8)
axes[1].plot(cuts,[s["ecnet"] for s in summary],"o-",color="#1b4f72",label="E. coli K-12 Cse1")
axes[1].plot(cuts,[s["panet"] for s in summary],"s--",color="#7d6608",label="P. aeruginosa Cas8e")
axes[1].axhline(0,color="k",lw=0.8)
axes[1].set_xlabel("shell around the PAM duplex (A)"); axes[1].set_ylabel("net charge (K+R) - (D+E)")
axes[1].set_title("Net charge of the PAM-binding patch"); axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
